module_summary: 16-bit ripple-carry adder built from two chained add8 instances, the low byte's carry Co_temp feeding the high byte.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: 16-bit operand A, split into low and high bytes for the two add8 children.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: 16-bit operand B, split into low and high bytes for the two add8 children.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: 16-bit sum assembled from both add8 children's byte results.

anchors.name: Co_temp
anchors.why: Ripple carry from low add8 into the high add8's carry-in.

anchors.name: Co
anchors.why: Final carry-out produced by the high add8 instance.

groups.name: ripple_adder_chain
groups.description: Two add8 blocks chained low-to-high through Co_temp, producing 16-bit sum and carry-out.
